name: @dsheiko/boilerplate
description: A collection of 20 frontend and full-stack starter templates covering React, Vue, Svelte, SolidJS, Webpack, Vite, Rspack, TypeScript, and more

scripts.install:all: for d in express playwright postcss puppeteer-jest react-antdesign-ssr react-nextjs react-redux react-redux-typescript react-vite-mantine react-zustand rspack-babel solidjs-store svelte-store vue-nuxt vue-pinia webpack-babel webpack-images webpack-sass webpack-sqip webpack-typescript; do echo "\n→ $d" && npm install --prefix $d; done
